strategy_roster.name: Donchian Channel Reversal
strategy_roster.notes: Failed lower-band breakout: prior close below channel low, current close moves back above it (Period=20). Corpus exits only on stop; channel re-cross added as exit proxy so positions do not ride to window end. StopLoss=2% documented.

strategy_roster.name: Donchian Volume
strategy_roster.notes: Upper-channel breakout with volume confirmation (VolumeMultiplier default undocumented, used 1.5x); exit when close returns inside channel or volume fades below average. StopLoss=2% documented.

strategy_roster.name: Macd Volume
strategy_roster.notes: MACD(12,26,9) bullish cross filtered by volume above average (VolumeMultiplier default undocumented, used 1.5x); exit on opposite cross. Corpus stop is percent-based but StopLossPercent value undocumented; left null.

strategy_roster.name: Momentum Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: Momentum(=roc 14) above its 20-bar mean plus 2 std (Multiplier=2.0); exit when momentum returns below its average. StopLossPercent=2 documented.

strategy_roster.name: RSI Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(14) above its 20-bar mean plus 2 std (Multiplier=2.0); exit when RSI crosses back below its average. StopLossPercent=2 documented.

strategy_roster.name: Bollinger Percent B Reversion
strategy_roster.notes: Percent B < 0 (close below lower band, Period=20, Dev=2.0); exit when close returns through the middle band (Percent B crosses ExitValue=0.5 approx). StopLossPercent=2 documented.

strategy_roster.name: ZScore
strategy_roster.notes: Z-score(20) below -2.0 (extreme low) anticipating reversion; exit when z-score normalizes above 0.0 (ZScoreExitThreshold=0). MAPeriod=20/StdDevPeriod=20. StopLossPercent=2 documented.

strategy_roster.name: ATR Reversion
strategy_roster.notes: Close more than 2x ATR(14) below MA(20) fades the spike; exit when close crosses back above MA. AtrMultiplier=2.0 documented. StopLossPercent=2 documented.

strategy_roster.name: Keltner Channel Reversal
strategy_roster.entry_long: close < ema(close,20) - 2 * atr(high,low,close,14) and close > open
strategy_roster.notes: Bullish candle closing below lower Keltner band (EMA20 center - 2*ATR14) fades the push outside; exit when price crosses back through center EMA. Corpus stop is ATR-based (2x), not representable as fixed pct; left null.

strategy_roster.name: Equivolume Bars
strategy_roster.notes: Volume spike above 2x its lookback sum/baseline with a bullish candle; exit when volume drops back to average or the candle turns bearish. Lookback defaulted to 20, threshold 2.0; corpus stop undocumented, left null.

strategy_roster.name: Historical Volatility Ratio
strategy_roster.notes: HVR approximated as ratio of short(6)-to-long(100)-period realized vol (std of 1-bar returns); long on volatility regime expansion (RatioThreshold 1.0, entry relaxed to 1.2), exit when ratio reverts below 1. Corpus has no fixed stop; left null.
